cohort: 250 pre-menopausal Kashmiri women with diagnosed dysfunctional uterine bleeding (DUB)
finding: There was a statistically significant relationship between treatment modality and outcome across all endometrial thickness levels (p<0.001), with medical treatment being highly successful (97.5%) for endometrial thickness between 8-9.9mm, and D&C with levonorgestrel IUD having a 100% success rate.
